Action Steps

Interview Guide
- [ ] Add a sensory question to Q6 or Q7 — e.g. "What senses are most affected when you're bored? What do you find yourself reaching toward — sound, touch, visuals?"
- [ ] Note to self during interviews: stay flexible with question order, jump ahead if the conversation leads there naturally

Participant Selection
- [ ] Once survey responses come in, review demographic data and responses before scheduling anyone
- [ ] Map respondents to rough personas — identify extremes (youngest/oldest, healthiest/unhealthiest phone relationship)
- [ ] Select interview participants based on range, not just availability

Interview Timeline
- [ ] Set a hard deadline for when interviews will be done and synthesis begins

Cultural Probe
- [ ] Look through Chris P(erry) Bacon's cultural probe examples in the precedents tab
- [ ] Design the probe: draft instructions asking participants to photograph their environment + log a note every time they feel bored
- [ ] Decide on format — how will they send entries back? (text, email, shared doc?)
- [ ] Identify who to reach out to for participation

Advisor Meetings
- [ ] Schedule a meeting with Jamie Shushan — bring a structured outline or visual of the process and project trajectory; set goals in advance
- [ ] Schedule Megan Reitz meeting for after data is compiled — she can help validate insights before moving into prototyping
